_doc: Engine dev test kit. Spawned ONCE per name+slot the first time a dev character (names in DEV_REVIVE_NAMES) loads a save, in ANY game built on this engine. NO ITEM NAMES ARE HARDCODED: every entry is resolved against the ACTIVE game's catalogs by WHAT THE ITEM IS, so the kit adapts to any re-skin. Edit this file to change the kit — no code change needed. 'consumables': each row grants 'qty' of the first item whose tags match the role 'tags', read from the active gear/materials/exploration catalogs (deduped across roles). 'gear': rule-based rare equipment read from the active armor/weapons catalogs — perSlot grants one item of 'rarity' for each armor slot; perRange grants one weapon of 'rarity' for each combat distance band (ranged->distant, throwable->far, long->mid, melee->close). A role/slot/range with no match in the loaded game is skipped (never an improvised fallback). OPTIONAL: a consumable row may add "prefer": "<exact item name>" to pin a specific item when that name exists in the loaded catalog; omitted here so resolution stays purely tag/type-based.
